text:
Ava M (Marketing): Quick sync — finalizing X / LinkedIn schedule for the May 2 webinar. Need: post copy, 2 hero images, 3 quote cards, and CTAs. Also need seedlist + SDR routing for inbound. Who can own monitoring first 24h?
Liam R (Social): I can own monitoring during US hours. Proposed post times: X at 9:30am PT, LinkedIn at 10am PT. Want to A/B headline on X (short hook vs. stat).
Priya S (Content): Cool. Drafted two caption variants: Variant A (hook): "Meet the latency killers — and how to fix them. Join our webinar May 2." Variant B (benchmark narrative): "See how teams cut token costs 3x without sacrificing quality — live demo May 2." Which tone do we want?
Noah G (Growth): For paid seeding we should prioritize the benchmark narrative (Variant B). Organic can run Variant A. Also need UTM params and landing link: https://redwood.ai/webinar-register
Rafa D (Design): ETA for hero + quote cards is end of day tomorrow. I'll deliver 2 hero sizes (1200x628 and 1080x1080) and three quote PNGs with transparent bg. Filenames will be: webinar-hero-1.png, webinar-hero-2.png, q1-card.png, q2-card.png, q3-card.png
Mariela (Ops): SDR routing — please confirm if inbound goes to SDR rotation or AE. If SDR, I'll add the webinar tag in HubSpot and set priority. Also we need the quick reply templates.
Ava M (Marketing): SDR please. We want fast follow-up. Mariela, go ahead. Liam will monitor public replies and surface high-intent leads to SDRs.
Liam R (Social): I'll create a lightweight monitoring doc and a slack alert flow. For amplification: schedule organic posts + 6 micro-boosts over 48h. Who approves paid budget?
Noah G (Growth): I can approve up to $2k for initial seed. Send me the seedlist CSV and UTM examples.
Priya S (Content): Dropping suggested engagement replies for the team to use (short + personalized):
- "Thanks — will send the registration link: https://redwood.ai/webinar-register"
- "Happy you’re curious — which use case are you focused on?"
- "We’ll share the recording after — please register so we can follow up."
Priya S (Content): Also adding the follow-up DM template for SDRs: 
```
Hi {first_name}, thanks for the interest on our post. Quick Q: are you evaluating latency/cost right now? If so, can I connect you with an engineer for a short call? Register here: https://redwood.ai/webinar-register
```
Rafa D (Design): Quick note on assets — can we get final logo lockup from Brand? I used the latest, but want confirmation before export.
Mariela (Ops): SDR routing details: will tag inbound with "webinar-may2" and create an automatic task for the on-call SDR. Please map to rotation: SDR-A (Mon/Wed/Fri morning) then SDR-B (Tue/Thu). I'll post rotation in #inbound.
SDR-Bot: Ticket created: WB-2023. Added tag webinar-may2. Assigned to SDR-A (next shift).
Ava M (Marketing): Perfect. Calls to action we want to test: "Register" vs "See the demo". Liam, schedule A/B on X (A=Register, B=See the demo). Priya, please add short alt-copy for LinkedIn with 2 CTAs.
Priya S (Content): Done. LinkedIn copy with dual CTAs: short lead + parenthetical CTA. Example: "Live demo: how we cut token cost 3x — Register (or choose 'See the demo' for a calendar invite)."
Noah G (Growth): UTM example for tracking (use these keys in creators' scheduling tool):
```
?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=webinar_may2&utm_content=variantA
```
Liam R (Social): I'll post the scheduling CSV to the shared drive. Example rows I’ll use for Ops: 
```
post_time,platform,copy,image,utm
2026-05-02T09:30:00-07:00,X,"Variant A copy",webinar-hero-1.png,"?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=webinar_may2&utm_content=variantA"
2026-05-02T10:00:00-07:00,LinkedIn,"LinkedIn copy",webinar-hero-2.png,"?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=webinar_may2"
```
Ava M (Marketing): Deadline checklist: assets in drive by EOD tomorrow, captions finalized by EOD today, seedlist CSV to Noah by 10am PT tomorrow, monitoring doc live by Liam before go-live. Anyone blocked?
Rafa D (Design): Not blocked. Will ping Brand for lockup now.
Noah G (Growth): Not blocked. Will send seedlist CSV (sanitized) by 09:45 PT.
Liam R (Social): Not blocked. Scheduling draft up in 30m for review.
Mariela (Ops): I'll set the HubSpot tag + SDR task automation after I get final registration link.
Ava M (Marketing): Awesome team — thanks. I’ll circle back once the scheduling draft is posted. :rocket:
